use: Offline analysis only; no generation or scoring calls initiated by this file.
outcome_separation: free-text support, role, scope and time
original-card revision, unintended duplicate, wrong merge, conflict
unsafe model proposal, guard rejection, executed side effect
native task success, complete arc, clean success, complete lifecycle
Host/writer/repair/embed calls, charged and known tokens, unknown usage, wall latency, storage
paired_unit: Same source history/arc/base task under both arms. Clean/anomaly variants and seeds remain paired within that unit.
dependency_cluster: Connected component of shared source history and predeclared task graph/template family. Variants, seeds and arm instances never create extra independent clusters. Cluster metadata is registered before outcomes.
weights: Equal weight per base task within each separately reported condition/workflow; preserving all paired variants when resampling a cluster. Do not pool MemSyco tasks into one accuracy.

bootstrap.resampling: Uniform sampling of independent dependency clusters with replacement; carry all paired task/condition/arm rows; recompute the equal-base-task mean in each replicate. Use the same draw for utility and cost differences.
bootstrap.interval: Percentile 2.5%/97.5% paired difference interval. Report exact independent cluster and base-task counts.
bootstrap.small_cluster_rule: Below20 independent clusters report paired descriptive differences, missing bounds and denominators only. This operational threshold does not guarantee coverage for any particular distribution.

clean_noninferiority.delta: M clean success rate minus B6_PLUS clean success rate
clean_noninferiority.rule: 95% lower paired interval must be at least -0.05, including predeclared worst-case missing bounds. A non-significant p-value or a high development pass count is not noninferiority.
clean_noninferiority.scoring_gate: Actual independent blind semantic review plus deterministic business scoring; Root/same-family development diagnoses do not satisfy this gate.

utility_cost_joint_report.utility: Paired task/lifecycle success difference with separate clean/anomaly/workflow results.
utility_cost_joint_report.policy: All maintenance/index/repair/restart/failed and truncated requests remain included. Report cost differences with the utility interval; do not infer dollar/GPU cost from tokens.

missingness.planned_results: Retain every planned arm/task row including NOT_RUN and infrastructure failures.
missingness.completion_metric: Incomplete lifecycle remains incomplete irrespective of fault cause.
missingness.semantic_scoring: Unscorable or ambiguous assertions remain null/UNKNOWN, never silently false, true or zero cost.
missingness.additional_complete_pair_report: Clearly labeled scorable-pair estimate only; it does not replace all-planned results.
missingness.utility_bounds: Lower difference assigns M unknown=0 and comparator unknown=1; upper difference assigns M unknown=1 and comparator unknown=0. Also display each-arm all-planned bounds.
missingness.cost_unknown: Preserve conservative charged reservations and known-only costs separately; unavailable latency/storage stays unmeasured.

sample_size.precision_target_for_planning: 95% paired clean success-difference interval half-width0.05, before formal results. Pilot dependency counts, paired variation and unknown rates must inform feasibility.
sample_size.final_decision: After new independent pilot and before any formal outputs, append exact source availability, dependencies, paired variance/precision calculation, final number and stopping rule to the formal runtime manifest. Do not sample until significance or treat zero observed pilot failures as zero population risk.
sample_size.fallback: If independent sources/scoring/precision are insufficient, retain unproven status and report that constraint; no pseudo-independent renamed templates.

public_anchors: MERIT native task/tool/scorer and MemSyco three task denominators are analyzed separately. Freeze official upstream commit and actual interface adaptations before runs.
conditional_expansion: Ablations/natural long horizon require E1-E3 support; Attention requires correct memory delivered plus ordinary Q/W insufficiency; EAL requires natural visible authorization evidence.
not_claimed: No method advantage or Product readiness
